Q5100.reason: Prior gun violence made a shooting that could injure the next-door neighbor a foreseeable risk the owner could have reduced by evicting, so liability rests on awareness of that danger rather than bare knowledge of drug dealing or a blanket no-duty rule.

Q5421.reason: Intramuscular ATP alone supports only about 1–2 seconds of all-out work; the roughly 10-second figure is the combined ATP–phosphocreatine system.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s “hitherto” marks a historical description of progressive societies he had studied, and the line is commonly misread as a prediction of later legal development.
